limitations: These are retained confirmed RPC account observations, not consensus-authenticated historical state proofs or a fresh RPC reread.

This snapshot-only review recomputes equality and exact commit effects and binds their address sets to retained transaction instructions; it does not independently reverify transaction signatures. The broader archived-demo verifier performs signature checks.
Tracked account bytes, owner, executable flag and lamports are compared; transaction fee payer and other untracked accounts are excluded.
Synthetic setup and chosen purchase amounts are test-observer disclosures; encrypted quota/account contents are not decrypted by this review.
